summary: Validated end-to-end the new procurement workflow additions on top of iteration_32's baseline. Backend pytest suite extended to 13/13 PASS covering the full happy path + reject→resubmit loop + pi_history archival + old rejected file remains downloadable + no-history case. Frontend Playwright as Admin verified: 5 filter tabs (Active/Approved/Rejected/Cancelled/All) with correct counts and filtering; a request that went reject→resubmit→approve appears under the 'Approved' tab (not 'Rejected'); the '1 rejected doc' link (data-testid rejected-docs-<id>) is present ONLY on requests with pi_history; clicking it opens the 'Previously rejected documents' dialog (pi-history-list) showing 'Rejected · v1', amount, admin reason 'UI-TEST rejection: wrong vendor', item lines, and a 'View document' link (pi-history-link-0) pointing at /api/files/<old_fid>/download. Direct GET on that old file returns HTTP 200 + application/pdf (GridFS serving works for archived docs). On the 'All' tab exactly ONE rejected-docs button was visible (the seeded pi_history request) — confirming the conditional visibility rule. Backend tests also cover: GridFS storage/download for PI/PO/Tax, admin approve → 'approved' directly (bypasses management even with a mgmt user assigned to the project), mgmt-action never gates the flow, admin cancel with reason, and clarify→resubmit path. All created procurement docs, GridFS blobs, files rows, and test users cleaned up (db.procurement.count()=0).

issues: po_issued still maps to reached=2 in REACHED (Procurement.jsx L10-14), same as 'approved' — Accounts stage remains 'active' visually after PO is issued. Suggest bumping po_issued to 3.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py resubmit_pi (~L2427-2475): pi_history archive is only pushed when a NEW file is included in the resubmit (`if file and doc.get('pi_file')`). If a site manager resubmits without changing the file, the rejection outcome is lost silently. Consider always pushing a history entry when transitioning from rejected/pending_clarification back to pending_admin (even without a new file, or reject the request in that case).
server.py resubmit_pi: original request status is copied into pi_history['outcome']. Good — history dialog uses this to show the 'Rejected · v1' pill.

HistoryDialog (Procurement.jsx): 'View document' link opens in a new tab with the JWT token as a query param (?token=...). Ensure the backend keeps this pattern secure (short-lived token as-is). Fine for now.
Procurement.jsx GROUPS.approved includes 'paid' but there is no 'paid' filter tab; rows in 'paid' state still surface under Approved — this is probably intended but worth confirming with product.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (filter tabs, rejected-docs conditional, history dialog with reason + old file link 200, approved req not on Rejected tab)
